crossRefs.note: “ ‘When anyone offers an offering of a meal offering to Yahweh, his offering shall be of fine flour. He shall pour oil…
He shall bring it to Aaron’s sons, the priests. He shall take his handful of its fine flour, and of its oil, with all…

parallels.note: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy…
gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy…

translations.web: If your offering is a meal offering of the pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
translations.bsb: If your offering is a grain offering cooked in a pan, it must consist of fine flour with oil.
translations.kjv: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in the fryingpan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
translations.asv: And if thy oblation be a meal-offering of the frying-pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
